name: vault-audit
summary: Deep structural audit of the vault: indexes, folder placement, frontmatter, links, Bases, and consistency.
done_when: workflow scope is satisfied or explicitly blocked
touched files are listed with paths
verification: verify changed Markdown/frontmatter where files were edited
verify wikilinks where notes were created or changed
verify open generated review artifacts have attention metadata and a Home Review Queue link
verify resolved Home Review Queue links are removed without deleting source evidence
